Method of Attack: Distribution via Visual Basic Macros (VBA) in Microsoft Word documents attached to phishing emails
Execution of PowerShell commands to retrieve and launch payload
Downloading DLL payloads and setting scheduled tasks for persistence
Partnering with ransomware operations to provide initial network access
Downloading additional modules to grab browser cookies, passwords, emails, drop Cobalt Strike, enable lateral movement, and proxy C2 traffic
Impacted Systems: Windows systems infected by QBot payload
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious Microsoft Word attachments containing VBA macros
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing emails with Word documents requiring 'Enable Content' to run macros
DLL files downloaded as core payload
Use of Cobalt Strike and lateral movement modules
